item.title: How I Containerized an STM32 Toolchain (Almost) Nobody Remembered
item.description: An old STM32 toolchain sat on a legacy server, set up by hand, its history almost lost. Here is how I turned it into a Docker container, with some AI detective work, and proved it builds the exact same firmware.
